name: api-forge
description: Local-first API integration intelligence for discovery, evidence-based diagnosis, fix planning, and native regression tests.

interface.shortDescription: From failing API to verified code fix
interface.longDescription: Map frontend calls to backend routes and schemas, execute APIs locally, inspect evidence, compare runs, create reviewed fix plans, and generate native regression tests through Codex.
